name: Brann

seo.title: Brann Build Guide: Stats, Abilities & Best Materials
seo.description: Brann is the tankiest character in Anvil Quest and the easiest way through floors 6 and 7. Full stats, all three abilities, and the materials that fix his damage.

summary: Brann hits like a hammer and moves like one too. He is the correct pick for anyone struggling with survivability, and the wrong pick for anyone who wants to finish a run quickly.
body:
Brann is the character the game gives you when you have died four times on floor 4 and are considering giving up. His health pool is roughly 40% larger than anyone else's, his damage reduction scales with missing health, and his abilities are all designed to make a bad situation survivable rather than to end a fight early.

The trade-off is speed. Brann's attack wind-up is the longest in the game, which means he cannot punish short-recovery enemies at all. Against anything that attacks in quick bursts, you will spend most of the fight blocking. His damage only becomes respectable once you attach a property that does work while he is not swinging — burning, chaining, or bleeding.

portrait.alt: Brann, a broad-shouldered blacksmith character with a heavy hammer

abilities.name: Anvil Stance
abilities.description: Brann plants his feet for three seconds, taking 60% reduced damage and reflecting 20% of blocked damage back at the attacker. Cannot move while active, which is exactly as dangerous as it sounds on floors with fire.

abilities.name: Overhead
abilities.description: A slow, telegraphed swing that deals triple damage and breaks enemy shields. The 1.4 second wind-up means you cannot use it reactively — you have to commit before the enemy commits.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Once per descent, restore 50% of max health when dropping below 20%. Automatic, no input required. This single ability is why Brann survives floors that kill everyone else.

tips: Pair Brann with a burning or bleeding property. His damage output while blocking is otherwise zero, and those two properties keep ticking through Anvil Stance.
Second Wind triggers automatically, so never panic-heal below 20% — let the ability fire first, then potion.
Overhead breaks the shields on floor 6 shielded enemies. Without it you are chipping through 80% damage reduction.

faq.q: Is Brann good in Anvil Quest?
faq.a: Brann sits in tier 2 of the roster. He is the most forgiving pick: the largest health pool and an automatic self-heal make floors 6 and 7 survivable without perfect play.
Max health 180, Base damage 22, Attack speed Slow, Damage reduction 15%, Move speed Slow.
All three characters are available from the start. There is no unlock requirement, and swapping between runs is free.
